incoming_learnings: A fish-adjacent chest does not establish the special pool room or its guaranteed invisibility supply. Preserve the chest obligation and habitat buffer, but develop preparation from actual public resources and executable routes. Incorrect intuition guesses are not positive item identifications. A safe potion-test bank alone does not establish a protected retrieval trip.

recommendations.reason: Revalidated for this recording through public reports and complete selecting source, not a full runtime reconstruction. No safe focused patch is established. The exact blocker is an unfunded remaining search: terminal supported food turns are zero, ordinary progression routes are absent, and required/committed search controllers retain hunger gates. Increasing the search ceiling would not satisfy those gates; adding them to generic searching would only terminate earlier. Next reconstruct and validate selections through decision 720, stopping at the first divergence, then probe copies for a fresh visible-wall search with an executable safe approach and travel-plus-search hunger budget before decision 723. Require accepted-search receipts and a new baseline-red/candidate-green regression for any supported correction. If no funded candidate exists, establish a bounded, evidence-backed health-loss search contract before changing admission. Preserve hazard checks, mandatory pickup and the terminal stuck label.

review.review: The living hero exhausted the planner, rather than dying. Ordinary exploration had no remaining tasks or reachable exit by decision 720 (line 2128). Wall searching then consumed the remaining food horizon. Decision 743 (selection 2191, accepted transition 2192) moved toward another search vantage despite zero optional hunger turns; hunger became starving. Seven cumulative searches exceeded the newly reduced four-search allowance. The committed-search helper separately rejects starvation and unfunded travel, while generic missing-exit searching lacks that admission. Decision 744 drank the known waterskin and restored full health (transition 2196); decision 745 stopped with no admitted rescue (2197). The late summoning-trap message does not establish prior trap knowledge or a killer. Source browsing resolves the selecting chain and search-admission contradiction, but no full runtime reconstruction or safe progress-producing alternative was validated. No patch is supplied: adding the missing hunger guard alone would stop earlier, while extending searches requires an unsupported starvation-risk contract. Existing focused tests passed: 36 tests, one skipped. The full original-source suite passed: 1,833 tests, four skipped. These results do not certify a replacement.
review.learnings: Treat missing-exit searching as an executable, costed task before hunger reserves disappear. A discovered secret is not evidence of an exit, and walking toward a search vantage is not a completed search. Keep mandatory pickup and hazard gates intact; neither extra waits nor guessed potion effects supplies missing progression.
